Where do loss functions come from? Not f.zh: 损失函数从何而来？并非凭空产生。假定你数据的残差服从某种噪声分布 $p(r)$，再去求解使数据最可能的参数。最大化似然即等价于最小化 $-\log p(r)$——@@T0@@它@@T1@@就是你的损失。改变噪声模型，便改变了损失。本页让三个面板保持同步，使你能够实时观察损失如何从概率密度中导出。
Where do loss functions come from? Not f.src: Where do loss functions come from? Not from thin air. Assume your data's residuals follow some noise distribution $p(r)$, then ask for the parameters that make the data most likely. Maximizing likelihood is minimizing $-\log p(r)$ — and that is your loss. Change the noise model, change the loss. This page keeps three panels in sync so you can watch the loss fall out of the density in real time.

@@T0@@~11 min@@T1@@\n @@T2@@Deep Le.zh:
@@T0@@约 11 分钟@@T1@@
      @@T2@@深度学习 · 损失函数 · 最大似然@@T3@@
@@T0@@~11 min@@T1@@\n @@T2@@Deep Le.src: ~11 min Deep Learning · Loss Functions · Maximum Likelihood

The one identity that runs the whole sho.zh: 贯通全篇的那一个恒等式
The one identity that runs the whole sho.src: The one identity that runs the whole show

Fit a line $\\hat{y}_i = w\\,x_i + b$ to.zh: 用一条直线 $\hat{y}_i = w\,x_i + b$ 拟合数据。每个点都有一个残差 $r_i = y_i - \hat{y}_i$。现在将这些残差@@T0@@建模@@T1@@为从密度 $p(r)$ 中抽取的随机噪声。假定各点相互独立，则整个数据集的似然为乘积 $\prod_i p(r_i)$。最大化它与最小化负对数似然是同一件事：
Fit a line $\\hat{y}_i = w\\,x_i + b$ to.src: Fit a line $\hat{y}_i = w\,x_i + b$ to data. Each point has a residual $r_i = y_i - \hat{y}_i$. Now model those residuals as random noise drawn from a density $p(r)$. Assuming the points are independent, the likelihood of the whole dataset is the product $\prod_i p(r_i)$. Maximizing it is the same as minimizing the negative log-likelihood:

So the @@T0@@loss function is literally.zh: 因此@@T0@@损失函数字面上就是 $-\log p(r)$@@T1@@。你曾做出的每一个选择——MSE、MAE、Huber 损失——都是对噪声形状的一次下注。假定高斯噪声，你就刚刚推导出了平方误差。假定拉普拉斯噪声，绝对误差便随之而来。下面让我们亲眼看看。
So the @@T0@@loss function is literally.src: So the loss function is literally $-\log p(r)$. Every choice you have ever made — MSE, MAE, a Huber loss — is a bet about the shape of the noise. Assume Gaussian noise and you have just derived squared error. Assume Laplace noise and out pops absolute error. Let's see it.

Density, loss, and fit &mdash; all at on.zh: 密度、损失与拟合——尽在一屏
Density, loss, and fit &mdash; all at on.src: Density, loss, and fit — all at once

Pick a noise model. The left panel draws.zh: 选择一种噪声模型。左侧面板绘制其密度 $p(r)$；右侧面板绘制由此得到的损失 $-\log p(r)$。它们下方是一个小型数据集以及一条由你控制的直线。密度曲线与损失曲线上的彩色圆点即你实际的残差；数据面板上的竖直短线则是落在地面上的同一批残差。总损失即这些逐点高度之和。
Pick a noise model. The left panel draws.src:
Pick a noise model. The left panel draws its density $p(r)$; the right panel
      draws the resulting loss $-\log p(r)$. Below them is a small dataset with a
      line you control. The colored dots on the density and loss curves are your
      actual residuals; the vertical stubs on the data panel are the same residuals
      down on the ground. The total loss is the sum of those per-point heights.

Laplace &rarr; absolute error.zh: 拉普拉斯 → 绝对误差

Noise density $p(r)$. Dots mark each res.zh: 噪声密度 $p(r)$。圆点标记每个残差的似然。
Noise density $p(r)$. Dots mark each res.src: Noise density $p(r)$. Dots mark each residual's likelihood.

Per-residual loss $-\\log p(r)$. Dot hei.zh: 逐残差损失 $-\log p(r)$。圆点高度 = 该点的损失。
Per-residual loss $-\\log p(r)$. Dot hei.src: Per-residual loss $-\log p(r)$. Dot height = that point's loss.

Data with your fitted line. Each vertica.zh: 附带你所拟合直线的数据。每根竖直短线都是一个残差，其着色反映它贡献的损失大小（绿色 = 代价低，红色 = 代价高）。
Data with your fitted line. Each vertica.src: Data with your fitted line. Each vertical stub is a residual, tinted by how much loss it contributes (green = cheap, red = expensive).

@@T0@@Do this.@@T1@@ Turn on @@T2@@Add o.zh: @@T0@@请试试。@@T1@@在高斯模型下开启@@T2@@添加一个离群点@@T3@@，然后点击 @@T4@@拟合所选损失@@T5@@。观察整条直线如何倾斜以追逐那一个坏点——平方误差付出 $r^2$ 的代价，因此远处的点会主导整个求和。现在切换到拉普拉斯或学生 t 并再次吸附拟合（拉普拉斯的拟合近似中位数直线）。稳健损失几乎纹丝不动，因为它们的尾部增长要慢得多。
@@T0@@Do this.@@T1@@ Turn on @@T2@@Add o.src: Do this. Turn on Add one outlier with the Gaussian model, then hit Fit selected loss. Watch the whole line tilt to chase the one bad point — squared error pays $r^2$, so a far point dominates the sum. Now switch to Laplace or Student-t and snap again (Laplace's fit is the median-like line). The robust losses barely flinch, because their tails grow far more slowly.

Why the tails are the whole story.zh: 为何尾部就是全部要害
Why the tails are the whole story.src: Why the tails are the whole story

Look only at the right-hand loss panel a.zh: 只看右侧的损失面板，观察它在残差@@T0@@很大@@T1@@时的表现：
Look only at the right-hand loss panel a.src: Look only at the right-hand loss panel and how it behaves for a large residual:

grows like $r^2$ &mdash; outliers domina.zh: 按 $r^2$ 增长 — 离群点主导

constant inside, $+\\infty$ outside.zh: 区间内为常数，区间外为 $+\infty$

a hard wall &mdash; any point outside is.zh: 一堵硬墙 — 任何落在区间外的点都被禁止
a hard wall &mdash; any point outside is.src: a hard wall — any point outside is forbidden

grows like $\\log r^2$ &mdash; very robu.zh: 按 $\log r^2$ 增长 — 极为稳健

That last column is the punchline. A los.zh: 最后一列才是点睛之笔。按 $r^2$ 增长的损失会让单个遥远的点获得极大的发言权；按 $|r|$ 或 $\log r$ 增长的损失则封顶了它的影响力。所谓「稳健回归」，无非就是假定了一个尾部更厚的噪声模型。
That last column is the punchline. A los.src:
That last column is the punchline. A loss that grows like $r^2$ lets a single far
      point buy an enormous vote; a loss that grows like $|r|$ or $\log r$ caps its influence.
      “Robust regression” is nothing more than assuming a heavier-tailed noise model.

@@T0@@Takeaway.@@T1@@ You do not choose.zh: @@T0@@要点。@@T1@@你选择的并非损失函数——你选择的是噪声模型，而损失就是 $-\log p(r)$，无论你承认与否。MSE 假定高斯噪声。MAE 假定拉普拉斯噪声。若你的数据存在离群点，那正是你的模型在告诉你：高斯的尾部太薄了。
@@T0@@Takeaway.@@T1@@ You do not choose.src: Takeaway. You do not choose a loss function — you choose a noise model, and the loss is $-\log p(r)$ whether you say so or not. MSE assumes Gaussian noise. MAE assumes Laplace noise. If your data has outliers, that is your model telling you the Gaussian tail is too thin.

meta.title: 从似然到损失
meta.tagline: 每一个损失函数都是伪装起来的噪声模型——选定密度，读出损失
meta.summary: 为你的残差选择一种噪声模型——高斯、拉普拉斯、均匀或学生 t——观察损失函数如何作为 -log p(r) 浮现出来。三个实时面板保持同步：噪声密度、逐残差损失曲线，以及在真实散点上的拟合直线。加入一个离群点，看清为何平方误差（高斯）会失效，而绝对误差（拉普拉斯）与学生 t 却泰然自若。
highlights: 在三个同步面板中，看恒等式 损失 = -log p(残差) 在四种噪声模型下生动呈现。
高斯噪声给出平方误差；拉普拉斯给出绝对误差；均匀给出硬性区间壁垒；学生 t 给出稳健的重尾损失。
切换单个离群点，观察最小二乘直线骤然偏移，而稳健拟合几乎不动。
拖动斜率与截距滑块，实时读出总损失作为逐点贡献之和的更新。
一劳永逸地理解 MSE 为何对离群点敏感、MAE 为何稳健——这完全取决于所假定噪声的尾部。
